title: Memory
subtitle: Inspect what your agents have stored under <code1>/v1/memory</code1>. Scoped to memories visible to your user / team (admins see all).
search_placeholder: Search by key, value, user ID...

empty_state.cta: Store your first memory entry to get started.

modal.key_hint: Globally unique — two memories cannot share a key. Namespace your own keys if you need per-user isolation (e.g. user:123:notes).
modal.value_hint: The stored text value. Empty strings are allowed.
modal.metadata_hint: Optional JSON dictionary for structured attributes. Leave empty to clear existing metadata on edit.
